QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] The Raging River
QuestInfo.0: Leon had something to say to you. You asked him what.
QuestInfo.1:
Leon believed he could go deeper with the completed Delfinos Hideout Map, but wanted to investigate the barrier further. He believed there were plants and ores that no one had seen before.

He asked that you use the map to delve deeper into the canals. Maybe you could find the Delfinos Hideout that way.
QuestInfo.2:
Leon believed he could go deeper with the completed Delfinos Hideout Map, but wanted to investigate the barrier further. He believed there were plants and ores that no one had seen before.He asked that you use the map to delve deeper into the canals. Maybe you could find the Delfinos Hideout that way.

You found the Delfinos Hideout as you hoped. Riverson was inside, furious that you had found him. He attacked you, and you had no choice but to battle him. 

You beat Riverson and calmed him down before asking him more about your investigation. He told you that he was part of the Delfinos hideout.

0.0: We should be able to get pretty far with this map, but I want to look around inside the barrier a little more. There's a lot of new plants and ores to find, untouched by people.
0.1: Speaking of which, I have a favor to ask you. I'll investigate around here, so can you go to the deep parts of the canal and eliminate any monsters on your way?

yes.0: The Delfino Hideout might be really close, so keep your eye out! Hunt any monsters you see and come back safely!

no.0: Did something come up? That's too bad... Talk to me when you want to investigate the deep parts of the canal.

0.msg: What did you see in there? Did you see the Delfino Hideout?

1.msg: Yup, it was there. And Riverson!

2.msg: Riverson was there? Did you get him too?

3.msg: Oh yeah, it was a tough battle.

4.msg: Great work! I guess the investigation ends here, then?

yes.0: Let's go report all this to my father. I'll be putting all the information together. Talk to me when you're ready!

mob.0: Eliminate any monsters you see in the deep ends of the canal!
